notes_for_editor: Core facts (1953 erection by the Georgia Forestry Commission, 100-foot Aermotor steel tower, 7 by 7 cab, staffed until the 1990s, now used for communications) rest on the NHLR entry and are corroborated by Forest Lookouts for the year and design. No source gives the staffing end year, fire history, or access or visit rules, so those are left out of facts. Elevation: NHLR gives elevation 100 ft (30 m), which matches our record's elevation_m 30.5, but tnlandforms.us lists 103 ft for the west bainbridge site, so the two sources differ by about 3 ft; not a record error category, so not in corrections. Record height_m 30.5 matches NHLR 100 ft. West Bainbridge identity: tnlandforms GA261 coordinates (30.91725, -84.59683) match the NHLR site (30.917480, -84.596030) to within about 0.001 degrees, so the two entries describe one tower. Photo: a Wikimedia Commons file (Forestry Commission Tower, Decatur County.jpg, CC BY-SA 4.0, EXIF author name Michael Rivera, uploader Mjrmtg, GPS date 15 July 2017) was found but its direct image URL was not fetched, so no photos entry was added; the editor can add it. Its caption places a Georgia Forestry Commission tower on Dothan Road in Bainbridge; the caption does not name the Decatur County Fire Tower, so the link to this tower is inferred. Two web searches and about five page reads were used. Fact-check 2026-10-08: the photo sentence now says a Georgia Forestry Commission tower and uses GPS date wording.
